terminal_closure.authorized_failure: all four matched Pearson/deviance comparator variants refused because transferred coordinates fell outside at least one pilot target's closed attainable fixed-margin interval
terminal_closure.post_failure_diagnostic: two of eight primary configurations were evaluable; all three ridge-only Haldane configurations also refused under the unchanged no-clipping rule

metadata_contract.annotation_provenance: Annotation_cell_type is an author-derived assay annotation used only to define the cell pool; no RNA or ADT matrix value enters eligibility or cell selection
metadata_contract.composition_eligibility: the exact 97 unique sample IDs in the bound official composition CSV, mapped to the 97 COMBAT_ID prefixes enumerated below
metadata_contract.sample_mapping: select only the exact enumerated (COMBAT_ID, scRNASeq_sample_ID) pair; exclude every other H5AD pair or timepoint, including one sharing a designated COMBAT_ID
metadata_contract.h5ad_pool_count_rule: record, for every mapped sample, the count of cells whose non-null Annotation_cell_type is in the exact eight-label H5AD allowlist; require at least 512
metadata_contract.total_pbmc_count_policy: record the official composition-file TotalPBMC_Count descriptively; do not require equality to the H5AD pool count
metadata_contract.failure_policy: any designated-pair absence or metadata inconsistency, eligibility, allowlist, minimum-count, institute, source-stratum, support, or matrix-schema discrepancy is a terminal pre-outcome refusal; outside-universe H5AD pairs are excluded and are not discrepancies; samples are never replaced

allocation.calibration_formula: within each Oxford Source, sort ascending SHA256(UTF-8('COMBAT-OXFORD-CALIBRATION-v1') || 0x00 || UTF-8(Source) || 0x00 || UTF-8(COMBAT_ID) || 0x00 || UTF-8(scRNASeq_sample_ID)), break digest ties by scRNASeq_sample_ID, and take 2
allocation.pilot_formula: remove calibration samples; within each Oxford Source, sort ascending SHA256(UTF-8('COMBAT-OXFORD-PILOT-v1') || 0x00 || UTF-8(Source) || 0x00 || UTF-8(COMBAT_ID) || 0x00 || UTF-8(scRNASeq_sample_ID)), break digest ties by scRNASeq_sample_ID, and take 4
allocation.locked_development_sample_order: the declared source_order followed by lexical COMBAT_ID order within each source and role; digest order determines membership only

oxford_held.definition: all 87 eligible Oxford samples in the frozen source manifest minus the exact 12 calibration and 24 pilot COMBAT_ID values

allocation.pilot_inference_status: adaptive development; selection and promotion use the same 24 samples
allocation.full_promotion_rule: field-transfer and graph-specific gates must pass in both held panels; no pooled result can replace either panel

cell_and_state_rules.cell_selection_formula: among exact-whitelist eligible cells, sort ascending SHA256(UTF-8('COMBAT-PBMC-CELL-BUDGET-v1') || 0x00 || UTF-8(COMBAT_ID) || 0x00 || UTF-8(scRNASeq_sample_ID) || 0x00 || UTF-8(obs_name)), break digest ties by obs_name, and take 512
cell_and_state_rules.rna_state: one iff the layers/raw Gene Expression count is greater than zero
cell_and_state_rules.adt_state: within sample and marker, sort by layers/raw ADT count then SHA256(UTF-8('COMBAT-PBMC-ADT-v1') || 0x00 || UTF-8(COMBAT_ID) || 0x00 || UTF-8(scRNASeq_sample_ID) || 0x00 || UTF-8(obs_name) || 0x00 || UTF-8(marker)); first 256 are lower and remaining 256 upper
cell_and_state_rules.informative_entity: fixed 2x2 margins admit more than one table

haldanes.observed_coordinate: for upper-left count a and fixed-margin cells a,b,c,d, h_M(a)=log((a+1/2)*(d+1/2)/((b+1/2)*(c+1/2))); z=h_M(a)-E_0[h_M(A)] under the exact fixed-margin hypergeometric null
haldanes.recipient_family: Fisher noncentral hypergeometric P_theta(A=a|M) proportional to P_0(A=a|M)*exp(theta*a)
haldanes.recipient_equation: solve E_theta[h_M(A)]-E_0[h_M(A)]=transferred z, then return the expected 2x2 table E_theta[T(A)]
haldanes.support_rules: enumerate exact integer support; exact attainable endpoints return flagged limiting tables; outside the closed attainable interval refuses; a one-table margin returns the flagged unique table and is excluded from informative loss
haldanes.interpretation: the pooled estimand is an expected centered Haldane coordinate, not a realized fractional upper-left count

pooling.method: entity-wise Paule-Mandel random-effects mean, heterogeneity, and precision
pooling.tau_solver: for w_i(t)=1/(v_i+t) and mu(t)=sum(w_i(t)*z_i)/sum(w_i(t)), use t=0 when sum(w_i(0)*(z_i-mu(0))^2)<=n-1; otherwise solve the unique nonnegative root equal to n-1
pooling.precision_normalization: divide positive PM precisions by their median

structured_solve.closed_form_scope: only this graph linear solve is closed-form; PM pooling and recipient reconstruction use one-dimensional root solves
structured_solve.failure_rule: refuse a nonfinite system, unsupported required entity, or condition number above the maximum

estimator.tie_break: first lexicographic (k, ridge, graph) tuple in the declared grid

graph_construction.cell_basis: the selected 512 cells per fit sample only
graph_construction.columns: all nonempty (fit sample, eligible Annotation_cell_type) strata in locked sample order then the exact eight-label allowlist order
graph_construction.rna_profile: binary detection prevalence in each stratum
graph_construction.adt_profile: stratum mean of per-cell log1p(100 * marker count / nine-marker ADT total); a zero-total cell contributes a zero vector
graph_construction.standardization: center and scale each marker profile across strata with ddof=1; zero variance refuses
graph_construction.neighbors: Euclidean directed k-nearest neighbors with locked-marker tie breaking, followed by undirected union and lexical edge order
graph_construction.incidence: one unweighted incidence column with exactly two unit entries per undirected edge
graph_construction.laplacian: L=I-D_v^(-1/2)*H*W*D_e^(-1)*H^T*D_v^(-1/2) on supported vertices, W=I, with isolated rows and columns zero
graph_construction.product: Kronecker sum kron(L_RNA,I_9)+kron(I_9,L_ADT), RNA-major and ADT-minor in the declared ordered entity list

classical_comparators.pooling: the same Paule-Mandel rules as the primary field
classical_comparators.target_restoration: under the Fisher noncentral-hypergeometric target family, solve E_theta[q_M(A)]=pooled q and return E_theta[T(A)]
classical_comparators.support_rules: enumerate full integer support and verify strict monotonicity; exact endpoints return flagged limiting tables; out-of-range targets refuse; one-table margins return the flagged unique table; zero null variance is unsupported
classical_comparators.pilot_selection: select the strongest of the four family-by-centering variants on the adaptive pilot

unstructured_comparator.name: ridge-only Paule-Mandel Haldane field
unstructured_comparator.selection: pilot-select by sample-equal deviance with lower ridge as the tie break
unstructured_comparator.matched_components: identical Haldane coordinate, Paule-Mandel pooling, precision normalization, and recipient reconstruction; ridge=0 retains the raw PM pool

mandatory_reported_ablations: pilot-selected unstructured ridge-only Paule-Mandel Haldane field
estimator.destroyed_link_rule: within each source sample, order cells by SHA256(UTF-8('COMBAT-DESTROYED-LINK-v1') || 0x00 || UTF-8(scRNASeq_sample_ID) || 0x00 || UTF-8(obs_name)) and cyclically replace each ADT profile by the next profile; reuse the primary field's unpermuted marginal-profile graphs so only source joint tables change
estimator.label_permutation_rule: independently order RNA and ADT markers by SHA256(UTF-8('COMBAT-LABEL-PERMUTATION-v1') || 0x00 || UTF-8(modality) || 0x00 || UTF-8(marker)) and assign them to graph positions in lexical marker order

authorization.public_freeze_commit: must be exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters
authorization.binding_shape: authorization.bindings must contain exactly the declared names; each value is an object with the exact repository-relative path and lowercase 64-hex SHA-256
authorization.transitive_import_rule: every numerical estimator, comparator, reconstruction, loss, interval, or test module imported by the runner must be present; an added numerical import without a new preauthorization binding refuses
authorization.access_rule: validate the committed authorization and every binding before decoding any calibration or pilot matrix outcome

development.reduction_replay: before pilot selection, revalidate the public development authorization, verify the bound H5AD digest, deterministically regenerate all 36 authorized calibration and pilot records, and require canonical equality with the serialized reduction; read no held matrix row
development.fit: fit every one of the eight primary configurations, every classical residual candidate, and every required control on the 12 calibration samples
development.select: minimize sample-equal pilot deviance on the 24 pilot samples; apply the declared tie break

pilot_gate.bootstrap_unit: sample, with shared resamples and linear 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles
pilot_gate.inference_status: adaptive promotion heuristic, not confirmatory inference

development.refit: after a pilot pass, refit each selected configuration without retuning on all 36 calibration and pilot samples
development.failure_policy: any pilot gate failure closes the candidate without held margin or held pairing access

prediction_phase: validate the separate public held-RNA-margin authorization and all immutable source, code, protocol, designation, development-result, and selected-model bindings
write an exclusive terminal held-prediction attempt before the first held margin request

launch a separate permit-bound subprocess that scans selected CSR row pointers and full feature-index slices, decodes numeric data values only at the nine RNA columns, emits only 81 aggregate row margins per sample, closes the source, and exits
record that row-CSR structural indices expose cross-modality sparsity positions inside the child, while the frozen code discards and emits none of them
use the design-implied fixed ADT margin [256,256] for every marker without decoding a held ADT numeric value or forming an empirical ADT state, margin, or RNA-ADT pairing
materialize and hash complete predictions for every method
public_freeze_before_pairing: publish prediction bytes at an immutable 40-hex Git commit URL
publish a separate authorization binding prediction, source, protocol, designation, code, model, and development-result hashes
fetch and verify prediction and authorization byte-for-byte
score_phase: write one exclusive terminal score-attempt record after public verification
only then open RNA and ADT together once to form truth tables and losses
held_access.prediction_seal_scope: numeric-value and RNA-ADT-pairing seal; not information-theoretic blindness to ADT sparsity support inside the isolated row-CSR child

inference.loss: for truth T and finite nonnegative margin-preserving prediction T_hat, D=(2/N)*sum over T_ij>0 of T_ij*log(T_ij/T_hat_ij); truth-positive/prediction-zero gives +infinity and truth-zero contributes zero; average equally across informative entities within sample and then equally across samples; nonfinite or negative predicted cells or margin mismatch refuse, whereas infinite loss from a valid limiting endpoint is a scored failure
inference.contrast: primary sample loss minus comparator sample loss
inference.relative_reduction: 1 - sample-equal mean primary loss / sample-equal mean comparator loss; the comparator mean must be finite and strictly positive, and a nonfinite or undefined gate statistic cannot pass
inference.sign_test: exact one-sided binomial upper tail under favorable probability one-half; a strictly negative primary-minus-comparator loss is favorable and zero is nonfavorable; panel size remains fixed

graph_specific_claim_gate.comparator: frozen pilot-selected unstructured ridge-only Paule-Mandel Haldane field
graph_specific_claim_gate.required_in_each_held_panel: paired 95% bootstrap upper endpoint for primary-minus-unstructured sample loss is below zero
graph_specific_claim_gate.effect_on_failure: retain any field-transfer result but set primary-method promotion to false
graph_specific_claim_gate.not_required: no 5% relative-reduction, favorable-count, or sign-test gate

inference.field_transfer_status: both classical-residual and destroyed-link comparators must pass every gate in each panel, and both panels must pass
inference.primary_method_promotion: field transfer must pass and the graph-specific paired upper 95% endpoint must be below zero in both panels
inference.multiple_candidate_scope: candidate-specific confirmatory inference; no familywise correction is claimed across earlier public candidate searches
inference.mandatory_reporting: all methods, per-sample losses, paired intervals, exact sign tests, support counts, exclusions, hashes, and refusals are retained separately for Oxford and St_Georges
